author: Adelaar, K. A.
title: New ideas on the early history of Malagasy
notes: Consulted directly on 25 November 2026 (PDF in Downloads; Table 1 read from the page image). A review of Simon (1988) and Mahdi (1988). Mahdi's Table 1 (p. 9) traces the changes from PAN via Proto-Barito, Proto-East Barito and Proto-South-East Barito to Proto-Malagasy and Merina; Hudson's (1967: 34) and Mahdi's East Barito trees are compared in Figures 2 and 4. Adelaar argues against Mahdi's East Austronesian substratum for the Malagasy word-final changes and against Simon's chronology. Volume and series details as commonly cited; the PDF has no title page.
